# LOAD DATA 
```{r load_data}
set.seed(123)

counts  <- read.csv("Merged_Count.csv", row.names = 1, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
coldata <- read.csv("ColData.csv", row.names = 1)
common  <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(coldata))
counts  <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
coldata <- coldata[common, , drop = FALSE]

# ---- Sedentary-behavior quartile cut-points ----
recompute_quartile_labels <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  q1 <- quantile(x, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)
  q3 <- quantile(x, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)
  case_when(
    x <= q1 ~ paste0("Lower than or equal to ", round(q1, digits)),
    x >= q3 ~ paste0("Greater than or equal to ", round(q3, digits)),
    TRUE    ~ "Interquartile range"
  )
}

coldata$sed60num_quartile_trimester1 <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$sed60num_trimester1)
coldata$sed60num_quartile_trimester2 <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$sed60num_trimester2)
coldata$sed60num_quartile_trimester3 <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$sed60num_trimester3)
coldata$sed60num_quartile_postpartum <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$sed60num_postpartum)
coldata$mvpa_quartile_trimester1     <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$mvpa_trimester1)
coldata$mvpa_quartile_trimester2     <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$mvpa_trimester2)
coldata$mvpa_quartile_trimester3     <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$mvpa_trimester3)
coldata$mvpa_quartile_postpartum     <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$mvpa_postpartum)

# DESeqDataSet — filtered
dds0 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~ 1)
dds0 <- dds0[rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 5) >= 3, ]

# Save background miRNA list for DIANA
miRNA_for_background <- rownames(dds0)
write.table(miRNA_for_background, file = "DIANA_background_miRNAs.txt",
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

# VST for PCA and expression plots
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds0, blind = TRUE)
count_mat <- assay(vsd)

# ---- Shared theme ----
jn_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.line        = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin      = margin(4, 6, 4, 4)
  )
```

# FIGURE 6 — Correlation Analysis + Regression Plots: PC1 & PC2 vs SED60+ and MVPA30
```{r fig6}
# PCA (numerical) using VST + prcomp on top variable genes
library(DESeq2)
library(matrixStats)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)

# ---- 0. Load Data & Align ----
counts <- read.csv("Merged_Count.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
coldata <- read.csv("ColData.csv", row.names = 1)
common <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(coldata))
counts <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
coldata <- coldata[common, , drop = FALSE]
coldata$sed60num_quartile_trimester1 <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$sed60num_trimester1)
coldata$sed60num_quartile_trimester2 <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$sed60num_trimester2)
coldata$sed60num_quartile_trimester3 <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$sed60num_trimester3)
coldata$sed60num_quartile_postpartum <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$sed60num_postpartum)
coldata$mvpa_quartile_trimester1     <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$mvpa_trimester1)
coldata$mvpa_quartile_trimester2     <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$mvpa_trimester2)
coldata$mvpa_quartile_trimester3     <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$mvpa_trimester3)
coldata$mvpa_quartile_postpartum     <- recompute_quartile_labels(coldata$mvpa_postpartum)

# ---- 1. DESeqDataSet and Filter Low-count Features ----
dds0 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~ 1)
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 5) >= 3
dds0 <- dds0[keep, ]

# ---- 2. Variance Stabilizing Transformation (VST) ----
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds0, blind = TRUE)
mat <- assay(vsd)

# ---- 3. Select Top Variable Genes ----
n_top <- 500
rv <- rowVars(mat)
top_genes <- order(rv, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(n_top, length(rv)))]
mat_top <- mat[top_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# ---- 4. Perform PCA ----
pc <- prcomp(t(mat_top), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
percentVar <- 100 * (pc$sdev^2) / sum(pc$sdev^2)
pvar_df <- tibble(PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(percentVar)), PercentVariance = percentVar)

# Sample scores
scores <- as.data.frame(pc$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  left_join(rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(coldata), var = "Sample"), by = "Sample")

# Gene loadings
loadings <- as.data.frame(pc$rotation) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Feature")

# ---- 5. Save Outputs (Uncomment to save) ----
# write.csv(pvar_df, "PCA_percent_variance.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# write.csv(scores, "PCA_sample_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# write.csv(loadings, "PCA_feature_loadings_topGenes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ---- 6. Correlation Analysis ----
run_correlation <- function(x, y, method = c("pearson", "spearman"), B = 5000, exact = FALSE) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  complete_idx <- complete.cases(x, y)
  x <- x[complete_idx]
  y <- y[complete_idx]
  
  # Correlation test
  cor_res <- cor.test(x, y, method = method, exact = if (method == "spearman") exact else NULL)
  
  # Bootstrap
  boot_vals <- replicate(B, {
    idx <- sample(seq_along(x), replace = TRUE)
    cor(x[idx], y[idx], method = method)
  })
  
  boot_CI <- quantile(boot_vals, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  
  list(cor_test = cor_res, boot_CI = boot_CI, n = length(x))
}

# Run correlation analysis (Pearson & Spearman) across ALL FOUR timepoints
PCs <- c("PC1", "PC2")
timepoint_labels <- c(T1 = "Trimester 1", T2 = "Trimester 2",
                       T3 = "Trimester 3", PP = "Postpartum")

activity_vars <- list(
  Sedentary = c(T1 = "sed60num_trimester1", T2 = "sed60num_trimester2",
                T3 = "sed60num_trimester3", PP = "sed60num_postpartum"),
  MVPA      = c(T1 = "mvpa_trimester1",     T2 = "mvpa_trimester2",
                T3 = "mvpa_trimester3",     PP = "mvpa_postpartum")
)

B <- 5000

# One row per test to run: 2 activities x 4 timepoints x 2 PCs = 16 rows.
# Building this as a plain data frame up front (instead of a nested for
# loop) makes it easy to see exactly which 16 tests are being run.
test_plan <- expand.grid(
  Activity  = names(activity_vars),
  Timepoint = names(timepoint_labels),
  PC        = PCs,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

correlation_results <- vector("list", nrow(test_plan))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(test_plan))) {
  activity  <- test_plan$Activity[i]
  tp        <- test_plan$Timepoint[i]
  pc        <- test_plan$PC[i]
  predictor <- activity_vars[[activity]][[tp]]

  res_pearson  <- run_correlation(scores[[pc]], coldata[[predictor]],
                                   method = "pearson", B = B)
  res_spearman <- run_correlation(scores[[pc]], coldata[[predictor]],
                                   method = "spearman", exact = TRUE, B = B)

  correlation_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    Activity          = activity,
    Timepoint         = tp,
    PC                = pc,
    pearson_r         = unname(res_pearson$cor_test$estimate),
    pearson_p         = res_pearson$cor_test$p.value,
    pearson_boot_lo   = res_pearson$boot_CI[1],
    pearson_boot_hi   = res_pearson$boot_CI[2],
    spearman_rho      = unname(res_spearman$cor_test$estimate),
    spearman_p        = res_spearman$cor_test$p.value,
    spearman_boot_lo  = res_spearman$boot_CI[1],
    spearman_boot_hi  = res_spearman$boot_CI[2],
    n                 = res_pearson$n
  )
}

correlation_summary <- bind_rows(correlation_results)

correlation_summary$pearson_p_adj_BH  <- p.adjust(correlation_summary$pearson_p, method = "BH")

correlation_summary$spearman_p_adj_BH <- p.adjust(correlation_summary$spearman_p, method = "BH")
rownames(correlation_summary) <- NULL

print(correlation_summary)
write.csv(correlation_summary, "PC_Correlation_Summary_Full16.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ---- Table (Pearson r/p and Spearman rho/p side-by-side) ----
sig_stars <- function(p) case_when(
  p < 0.001 ~ "***",
  p < 0.01  ~ "**",
  p < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE      ~ ""
)

table_S3_style <- correlation_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint       = factor(timepoint_labels[Timepoint],
                        levels = c("Trimester 1", "Trimester 2", "Trimester 3", "Postpartum")),
    Pearson_r_p     = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", pearson_r), " (p = ", sprintf("%.3f", pearson_p), ")", sig_stars(pearson_p)),
    Spearman_rho_p  = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", spearman_rho), " (p = ", sprintf("%.3f", spearman_p), ")", sig_stars(spearman_p)),
    Pearson_p_adj_BH  = sprintf("%.3f", pearson_p_adj_BH),
    Spearman_p_adj_BH = sprintf("%.3f", spearman_p_adj_BH)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Activity, Timepoint, PC) %>%
  dplyr::select(Activity, Timepoint, PC, Pearson_r_p, Spearman_rho_p,
                Pearson_p_adj_BH, Spearman_p_adj_BH, n)

colnames(table_S3_style) <- c("Activity", "Timepoint", "PC", "Pearson r (p)",
                               "Spearman \u03C1 (p)", "BH-adj. Pearson p",
                               "BH-adj. Spearman p", "n")

write.csv(table_S3_style, "TableS3_PC_Correlations_Full16.csv", row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(table_S3_style,
             caption = "PC1/PC2 vs. sedentary behavior and MVPA, all timepoints (n=11). BH correction applied across all 16 tests, separately for Pearson and Spearman. *p<0.05 **p<0.01 ***p<0.001 (unadjusted).")
```

# ============================================================
# DIAGNOSTIC — PCA Loading Contribution 
# ============================================================
```{r pca_loading_contribution}
mirna_to_check <- "hsa-miR-148a-3p"
n_pca_genes    <- nrow(loadings)   # genes actually used in PCA (top 500, or fewer if <500 passed filtering)
expected_uniform_pct <- 100 / n_pca_genes

contribution_df <- loadings %>%
  mutate(
    PC1_contribution_pct = (PC1^2) * 100,
    PC2_contribution_pct = (PC2^2) * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(PC2_contribution_pct))

mirna_row <- contribution_df %>% filter(Feature == mirna_to_check)

cat("PCA was built from", n_pca_genes, "miRNAs.\n")
cat("Expected contribution per gene if all contributed equally:",
    round(expected_uniform_pct, 3), "%\n\n")

for (pc_col in c("PC1_contribution_pct", "PC2_contribution_pct")) {
  vals      <- contribution_df[[pc_col]]
  pc_name   <- sub("_contribution_pct", "", pc_col)
  rank_val  <- match(mirna_row[[pc_col]], sort(vals, decreasing = TRUE))
  fold_over <- mirna_row[[pc_col]] / expected_uniform_pct
  z_val     <- (mirna_row[[pc_col]] - mean(vals)) / sd(vals)

  cat(pc_name, ": ", mirna_to_check, " contributes ", round(mirna_row[[pc_col]], 2),
      "% (rank ", rank_val, " of ", n_pca_genes, "; ", round(fold_over, 1),
      "x the expected uniform share; z = ", round(z_val, 1), " vs. the other ",
      n_pca_genes - 1, " genes)\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

write.csv(contribution_df %>% dplyr::select(Feature, PC1_contribution_pct, PC2_contribution_pct),
          "PCA_Loading_Contributions_AllGenes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

top10_pc1 <- contribution_df %>% arrange(desc(PC1_contribution_pct)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>% dplyr::select(Feature, PC1_contribution_pct)
top10_pc2 <- contribution_df %>% arrange(desc(PC2_contribution_pct)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>% dplyr::select(Feature, PC2_contribution_pct)

knitr::kable(top10_pc1, digits = 2, caption = "Top 10 contributors to PC1 (% of variance).")
knitr::kable(top10_pc2, digits = 2, caption = "Top 10 contributors to PC2 (% of variance) -- the sedentary/MVPA-associated axis.")

# ---- Bar plot of top contributors, miR-148a-3p highlighted, with a
# reference line at the "if every gene contributed equally" baseline ----
plot_contribution <- function(df, pc_col, pc_label, highlight = mirna_to_check, top_n = 20) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[pc_col]])) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    mutate(Feature   = factor(Feature, levels = rev(Feature)),
           Highlight = ifelse(Feature == highlight, "miR-148a-3p", "Other"))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Feature, y = .data[[pc_col]], fill = Highlight)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = expected_uniform_pct, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("miR-148a-3p" = "firebrick", "Other" = "grey60")) +
    labs(title    = paste0("Top ", top_n, " contributors to ", pc_label),
         subtitle = paste0("Dashed line = expected contribution if all ", n_pca_genes, " genes contributed equally"),
         x = NULL, y = "% contribution to component") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

fig_contrib_pc1 <- plot_contribution(contribution_df, "PC1_contribution_pct", "PC1")
fig_contrib_pc2 <- plot_contribution(contribution_df, "PC2_contribution_pct", "PC2")

fig_contrib_pc1
fig_contrib_pc2

ggsave("Figure_PCA_Contribution_PC1.tiff", plot = fig_contrib_pc1, device = "tiff", dpi = 300,
       width = 14, height = 10, units = "cm", compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
ggsave("Figure_PCA_Contribution_PC2.tiff", plot = fig_contrib_pc2, device = "tiff", dpi = 300,
       width = 14, height = 10, units = "cm", compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
```

# ============================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS — PCA Quartile vs. Continuous Concordance (n=11)
# ============================================================
```{r pca_concordance}
quartile_col_map <- list(
  Sedentary = c(T1 = "sed60num_quartile_trimester1", T2 = "sed60num_quartile_trimester2",
                T3 = "sed60num_quartile_trimester3", PP = "sed60num_quartile_postpartum"),
  MVPA      = c(T1 = "mvpa_quartile_trimester1",     T2 = "mvpa_quartile_trimester2",
                T3 = "mvpa_quartile_trimester3",     PP = "mvpa_quartile_postpartum")
)

compare_pca_quartile_continuous <- function(scores, pc, quartile_labels,
                                            pearson_r, pearson_p,
                                            spearman_rho, spearman_p, label) {
  low_mask  <- grepl("^Lower",   quartile_labels)
  high_mask <- grepl("^Greater", quartile_labels)

  pc_low  <- scores[[pc]][low_mask]
  pc_high <- scores[[pc]][high_mask]

  wt <- wilcox.test(pc_high, pc_low, exact = FALSE)
  mean_diff <- mean(pc_high) - mean(pc_low)   # High - Low, on the PC score

  # Continuous correlation direction is with respect to the RAW predictor
  # (higher predictor = more sedentary/more active), so a positive
  # mean_diff (PC score higher in the High-predictor group) is the SAME
  # real-world direction as a positive Pearson r for both Sedentary and
  # MVPA here -- unlike the DE models, the PCA correlation was always run
  # against the raw continuous predictor (never a Low-vs-High DESeq2
  # contrast), so there is no sign-convention mismatch to correct for.
  same_direction <- sign(mean_diff) == sign(pearson_r)

  data.frame(
    Comparison   = label,
    n_low        = length(pc_low),
    n_high       = length(pc_high),
    mean_diff_High_minus_Low = mean_diff,
    wilcox_p     = wt$p.value,
    pearson_r    = pearson_r,
    pearson_p    = pearson_p,
    spearman_rho = spearman_rho,
    spearman_p   = spearman_p,
    `Same direction (extreme groups vs. continuous)?` = ifelse(same_direction, "Yes", "No")
  )
}

pca_concordance_results <- vector("list", nrow(test_plan))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(test_plan))) {
  activity <- test_plan$Activity[i]
  tp       <- test_plan$Timepoint[i]
  pc       <- test_plan$PC[i]
  qcol     <- quartile_col_map[[activity]][[tp]]

  stats_row <- correlation_summary %>%
    filter(Activity == activity, Timepoint == tp, PC == pc)

  pca_concordance_results[[i]] <- compare_pca_quartile_continuous(
    scores, pc, coldata[[qcol]],
    pearson_r    = stats_row$pearson_r,
    pearson_p    = stats_row$pearson_p,
    spearman_rho = stats_row$spearman_rho,
    spearman_p   = stats_row$spearman_p,
    label        = paste0(activity, " ", pc, " (", timepoint_labels[[tp]], ")")
  )
}

pca_quartile_continuous_concordance <- bind_rows(pca_concordance_results)
pca_quartile_continuous_concordance$wilcox_p_adj_BH <- p.adjust(
  pca_quartile_continuous_concordance$wilcox_p, method = "BH")

n_concordant <- sum(pca_quartile_continuous_concordance$`Same direction (extreme groups vs. continuous)?` == "Yes")
cat(n_concordant, "/", nrow(pca_quartile_continuous_concordance),
    "PC tests show the same real-world direction between the extreme-quartile",
    "comparison and the full-sample continuous correlation.\n")

write.csv(pca_quartile_continuous_concordance, "PCA_Quartile_vs_Continuous_Concordance.csv", row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(pca_quartile_continuous_concordance, digits = 3,
             caption = "PCA quartile (Low/Q1 vs. High/Q3, n=11) vs. continuous (Pearson/Spearman) concordance, all 16 PC x activity x timepoint tests.")
```

```{r fig6_regression}
# ---- 8. Regression Plots (PC2 vs. sedentary behavior, all 4 timepoints),
# annotated with BOTH the raw (unadjusted) and BH-adjusted p-values ----
plot_pc2_vs_predictor <- function(scores, coldata, predictor_col, quartile_col,
                                   tp_label, tp_key, correlation_summary) {
  plot_df <- scores %>%
    mutate(
      Predictor = coldata[[predictor_col]],
      # Simplify the exact numeric quartile label (e.g. "Lower than or
      # equal to 94.3") down to a fixed 3-level group for coloring, so the
      # color scale never has to change based on what the cut-point values
      # happen to be.
      QuartileGroup = case_when(
        grepl("^Lower",   coldata[[quartile_col]]) ~ "Low (Q1)",
        grepl("^Greater", coldata[[quartile_col]]) ~ "High (Q3)",
        TRUE                                        ~ "Interquartile range"
      ),
      QuartileGroup = factor(QuartileGroup,
                              levels = c("Low (Q1)", "Interquartile range", "High (Q3)"))
    )

  stats_row <- correlation_summary %>%
    filter(Activity == "Sedentary", Timepoint == tp_key, PC == "PC2")

  annotation_text <- paste0(
    "Pearson r = ", sprintf("%.2f", stats_row$pearson_r),
    ", p = ", sprintf("%.3f", stats_row$pearson_p),
    " (BH-adj p = ", sprintf("%.3f", stats_row$pearson_p_adj_BH), ")\n",
    "Spearman \u03C1 = ", sprintf("%.2f", stats_row$spearman_rho),
    ", p = ", sprintf("%.3f", stats_row$spearman_p),
    " (BH-adj p = ", sprintf("%.3f", stats_row$spearman_p_adj_BH), ")"
  )

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Predictor, y = PC2, color = QuartileGroup)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = TRUE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Low (Q1)" = "red",
                                   "Interquartile range" = "darkgreen",
                                   "High (Q3)" = "royalblue")) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = annotation_text,
             hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.3, size = 3, fontface = "italic") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("PC2 vs. SED60+ (", tp_label, ") by Quartile"),
      x = "Minutes/day in prolonged sedentary bouts (\u226560 minutes)",
      y = "PC2",
      color = "Quartile"
    ) +
    theme_classic()
}

fig6A <- plot_pc2_vs_predictor(scores, coldata, "sed60num_trimester1", "sed60num_quartile_trimester1",
```

# miRNA DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION — DESeq2
# Sedentary behavior (SED60+) and MVPA, all timepoints
```{r deseq2}
run_deseq <- function(coldata, counts, group_col, reference_group, comparison_group,
                      output_file, group_labels = NULL) {
  coldata_filt <- coldata %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(group_col)) %>%
    filter(.data[[group_col]] != "Interquartile range") %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(grepl("Lower", .data[[group_col]]), "Low", "High")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Group)

  coldata_filt$Group <- factor(coldata_filt$Group, levels = c("Low", "High"))
  counts_filt        <- counts[, rownames(coldata_filt)]

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_filt,
                                colData   = coldata_filt,
                                design    = ~ Group)
  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) >= 5) >= 3, ]
  dds$Group <- relevel(dds$Group, ref = reference_group)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Group", comparison_group, reference_group))

  comparison_label <- if (!is.null(group_labels)) group_labels[[comparison_group]] else comparison_group
  reference_label   <- if (!is.null(group_labels)) group_labels[[reference_group]]  else reference_group

  degs <- na.omit(res[which(res$padj < 0.10), ])
  degs_df <- as.data.frame(degs)
  if (nrow(degs_df) > 0) {
    degs_df$Contrast  <- paste0(comparison_label, " vs. ", reference_label)
    degs_df$Direction <- ifelse(degs_df$log2FoldChange > 0,
                                 paste0("Higher in ", comparison_label, " (positive log2FC)"),
                                 paste0("Higher in ", reference_label, " (negative log2FC)"))
  }
  write.csv(degs_df, output_file)
  return(res)
}

# ---- Sedentary behavior (SED60+): reference = High (Q3, more sedentary) ----
sed_group_labels <- c(Low = "Low quartile (Q1, less sedentary)",
                       High = "High quartile (Q3, more sedentary)")

results_sedentary_T1 <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_trimester1", reference_group = "High", comparison_group = "Low",
  output_file = "results_sedentary_T1_DEGs_NAomit.csv", group_labels = sed_group_labels)
```

# ============================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS — Continuous Predictor (full n=11, no quartile split)
# ============================================================
```{r deseq2_continuous}
run_deseq_continuous <- function(coldata, counts, predictor_col, output_file, label) {
  coldata_filt <- coldata %>% dplyr::select(all_of(predictor_col))
  # Z-score the continuous predictor so log2FC is expressed "per 1 SD
  # increase in <predictor>" -- keeps coefficients interpretable and
  # comparable across variables/timepoints with very different raw units
  # and ranges (e.g. sedentary minutes/day vs. MVPA minutes/day).
  coldata_filt$Predictor_z <- as.numeric(scale(coldata_filt[[predictor_col]]))
  counts_filt <- counts[, rownames(coldata_filt)]

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_filt,
                                colData   = coldata_filt,
                                design    = ~ Predictor_z)
  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) >= 5) >= 3, ]
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  res <- results(dds, name = "Predictor_z")

  degs <- na.omit(res[which(res$padj < 0.10), ])
  degs_df <- as.data.frame(degs)
  if (nrow(degs_df) > 0) {
    degs_df$Contrast <- paste0(label, " (continuous, per 1 SD, n=", ncol(dds), ")")
  }
  write.csv(degs_df, output_file)
  return(res)
}

results_mvpa_PP_cont <- run_deseq_continuous(coldata, counts,
  "mvpa_postpartum", "results_mvpa_PP_continuous_DEGs_NAomit.csv", "MVPA PP")

# ---- Concordance table ----
compare_quartile_continuous <- function(quartile_res, continuous_res, label,
                                        invert_continuous_sign = FALSE) {
  q_df <- as.data.frame(quartile_res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("miRNA") %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.10) %>%
    dplyr::select(miRNA, log2FC_quartile = log2FoldChange, padj_quartile = padj)

  c_df <- as.data.frame(continuous_res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("miRNA") %>%
    dplyr::select(miRNA, log2FC_continuous = log2FoldChange,
                  p_continuous = pvalue, padj_continuous = padj)

  merged <- q_df %>%
    inner_join(c_df, by = "miRNA") %>%
    mutate(
      Comparison = label,
      log2FC_continuous_realworld = if (invert_continuous_sign) -log2FC_continuous else log2FC_continuous,
      `Same direction?`     = dplyr::if_else(sign(log2FC_quartile) == sign(log2FC_continuous_realworld), "Yes", "No"),
      `Nominally sig. (p<0.05) in continuous model?` = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(p_continuous) & p_continuous < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
    )

  if (nrow(merged) == 0) return(merged)

  merged$padj_candidateset <- p.adjust(merged$p_continuous, method = "BH")

  n_total      <- nrow(merged)
  n_concordant <- sum(merged$`Same direction?` == "Yes")
  n_confirmed  <- sum(merged$padj_candidateset < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(label, ":", n_concordant, "/", n_total,
      "quartile-significant miRNAs show the same real-world direction of effect,",
      n_confirmed, "/", n_total,
      "confirmed at candidate-restricted padj<0.10 in the continuous model.\n")

  merged
}

concordance_T1 <- compare_quartile_continuous(results_sedentary_T1, results_sedentary_T1_cont,
  "Sedentary T1", invert_continuous_sign = TRUE)
concordance_T2 <- compare_quartile_continuous(results_sedentary_T2, results_sedentary_T2_cont,
  "Sedentary T2", invert_continuous_sign = TRUE)
concordance_T3 <- compare_quartile_continuous(results_sedentary_T3, results_sedentary_T3_cont,
  "Sedentary T3", invert_continuous_sign = TRUE)
concordance_PP <- compare_quartile_continuous(results_sedentary_PP, results_sedentary_PP_cont,
  "Sedentary PP", invert_continuous_sign = TRUE)

concordance_mvpa_T1 <- compare_quartile_continuous(results_mvpa_T1, results_mvpa_T1_cont, "MVPA T1")
concordance_mvpa_T2 <- compare_quartile_continuous(results_mvpa_T2, results_mvpa_T2_cont, "MVPA T2")

concordance_mvpa_PP <- compare_quartile_continuous(results_mvpa_PP, results_mvpa_PP_cont, "MVPA PP")


quartile_continuous_concordance <- bind_rows(
  concordance_T1, concordance_T2, concordance_T3, concordance_PP,
  concordance_mvpa_T1, concordance_mvpa_T2, concordance_mvpa_T3, concordance_mvpa_PP
)
```

# ============================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS — Full-Dispersion 3-Level Group Model (full n=11)
# ============================================================
```{r deseq2_full_dispersion}
run_deseq_full_dispersion <- function(coldata, counts, group_col, reference_group, comparison_group,
                                      output_file, group_labels = NULL) {
  coldata_filt <- coldata %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(group_col)) %>%
    mutate(Group3 = case_when(
      grepl("Lower",   .data[[group_col]]) ~ "Low",
      grepl("Greater", .data[[group_col]]) ~ "High",
      TRUE                                 ~ "Mid"
    )) %>%
    dplyr::select(Group3)

  coldata_filt$Group3 <- factor(coldata_filt$Group3, levels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))
  counts_filt <- counts[, rownames(coldata_filt)]   # ALL n=11 -- no samples dropped before fitting

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_filt,
                                colData   = coldata_filt,
                                design    = ~ Group3)
  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) >= 5) >= 3, ]
  dds$Group3 <- relevel(dds$Group3, ref = reference_group)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  # Still only extracting the Low vs. High contrast -- the a priori
  # hypothesis is unchanged, only the dispersion/normalization fit uses
  # more information now.
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Group3", comparison_group, reference_group))

  comparison_label <- if (!is.null(group_labels)) group_labels[[comparison_group]] else comparison_group
  reference_label   <- if (!is.null(group_labels)) group_labels[[reference_group]]  else reference_group

  degs <- na.omit(res[which(res$padj < 0.10), ])
  degs_df <- as.data.frame(degs)
  if (nrow(degs_df) > 0) {
    degs_df$Contrast <- paste0(comparison_label, " vs. ", reference_label,
                               " (dispersion/size factors fit on full n=", ncol(dds), ")")
    degs_df$Direction <- ifelse(degs_df$log2FoldChange > 0,
                                paste0("Higher in ", comparison_label, " (positive log2FC)"),
                                paste0("Higher in ", reference_label, " (negative log2FC)"))
  }
  write.csv(degs_df, output_file)
  return(res)
}

# ---- Compare: does dispersion-sharing across the full n=11 change padj
# for the miRNAs already flagged by the original (n=6-7) quartile model? ----
compare_dispersion_approaches <- function(original_res, fulldisp_res, label) {
  orig_df <- as.data.frame(original_res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("miRNA") %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.10) %>%
    dplyr::select(miRNA, log2FC_original = log2FoldChange, padj_original = padj)

  full_df <- as.data.frame(fulldisp_res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("miRNA") %>%
    dplyr::select(miRNA, log2FC_fulldispersion = log2FoldChange,
                  padj_fulldispersion = padj)

  merged <- orig_df %>%
    inner_join(full_df, by = "miRNA") %>%
    mutate(
      Comparison = label,
      `Padj improved?` = dplyr::if_else(padj_fulldispersion < padj_original, "Yes", "No")
    )

  if (nrow(merged) == 0) return(merged)

  cat(label, ":", sum(merged$padj_fulldispersion < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE), "/", nrow(merged),
      "still significant (padj<0.10) once dispersion is estimated on the full n=11.\n")

  merged
}

dispersion_comparison <- bind_rows(
  compare_dispersion_approaches(results_sedentary_T1, results_sedentary_T1_fulldisp, "Sedentary T1"),
  compare_dispersion_approaches(results_sedentary_T2, results_sedentary_T2_fulldisp, "Sedentary T2"),
  compare_dispersion_approaches(results_sedentary_T3, results_sedentary_T3_fulldisp, "Sedentary T3"),
  compare_dispersion_approaches(results_sedentary_PP, results_sedentary_PP_fulldisp, "Sedentary PP"),
  compare_dispersion_approaches(results_mvpa_T1, results_mvpa_T1_fulldisp, "MVPA T1"),
  compare_dispersion_approaches(results_mvpa_T2, results_mvpa_T2_fulldisp, "MVPA T2"),
  compare_dispersion_approaches(results_mvpa_T3, results_mvpa_T3_fulldisp, "MVPA T3"),
  compare_dispersion_approaches(results_mvpa_PP, results_mvpa_PP_fulldisp, "MVPA PP")
)

write.csv(dispersion_comparison, "Quartile_vs_FullDispersion_Comparison.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# ============================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS — Trimester 2 with hsa-miR-148a-3p Excluded
# ============================================================
```{r sensitivity_exclude_148a}
mirna_to_exclude <- "hsa-miR-148a-3p"

counts_excl148a <- counts[rownames(counts) != mirna_to_exclude, , drop = FALSE]

cat("Original count matrix:", nrow(counts), "miRNAs\n")
cat("After excluding", mirna_to_exclude, ":", nrow(counts_excl148a), "miRNAs\n\n")

run_excl148a_check <- function(original_res, quartile_col, reference_group, comparison_group,
                               output_file, group_labels, label) {
  res_excl <- run_deseq(coldata, counts_excl148a, quartile_col, reference_group, comparison_group,
                        output_file, group_labels)

  sig_with    <- rownames(original_res)[which(original_res$padj < 0.05)]
  sig_without <- rownames(res_excl)[which(res_excl$padj < 0.05)]

  compare_df <- data.frame(miRNA = union(sig_with, sig_without)) %>%
    mutate(
      Comparison             = label,
      SignificantWith148a    = miRNA %in% sig_with,
      SignificantWithout148a = miRNA %in% sig_without,
      Status = case_when(
        SignificantWith148a & SignificantWithout148a  ~ "Consistent (robust to exclusion)",
        SignificantWith148a & !SignificantWithout148a ~ "Lost when miR-148a-3p excluded",
        !SignificantWith148a & SignificantWithout148a ~ "Gained when miR-148a-3p excluded",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  cat(label, ":", length(sig_with), "sig WITH miR-148a-3p,", length(sig_without),
      "sig WITHOUT; ", sum(compare_df$Status == "Consistent (robust to exclusion)", na.rm = TRUE),
      "/", nrow(compare_df), "consistent.\n")

  compare_df
}

# ---- All 4 timepoints, both activity variables (8 comparisons total) ----
sensitivity_148a_all <- bind_rows(
  run_excl148a_check(results_sedentary_T1, "sed60num_quartile_trimester1", "High", "Low",
                     "results_sedentary_T1_excl148a_DEGs_NAomit.csv", sed_group_labels, "Sedentary T1"),
  run_excl148a_check(results_sedentary_T2, "sed60num_quartile_trimester2", "High", "Low",
                     "results_sedentary_T2_excl148a_DEGs_NAomit.csv", sed_group_labels, "Sedentary T2"),
  run_excl148a_check(results_sedentary_T3, "sed60num_quartile_trimester3", "High", "Low",
                     "results_sedentary_T3_excl148a_DEGs_NAomit.csv", sed_group_labels, "Sedentary T3"),
  run_excl148a_check(results_sedentary_PP, "sed60num_quartile_postpartum", "High", "Low",
```

```{r pca_sensitivity_exclude_148a}
dds0_excl148a <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_excl148a, colData = coldata, design = ~ 1)
dds0_excl148a <- dds0_excl148a[rowSums(counts(dds0_excl148a) >= 5) >= 3, ]

vsd_excl148a <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds0_excl148a, blind = TRUE)
mat_excl148a <- assay(vsd_excl148a)

was_in_top500 <- mirna_to_exclude %in% rownames(mat)[top_genes]
cat(mirna_to_exclude, "was", ifelse(was_in_top500, "IN", "NOT in"),
    "the original top-", n_top, "-most-variable-gene set used for PCA.\n\n")

rv_excl148a <- rowVars(mat_excl148a)
top_genes_excl148a <- order(rv_excl148a, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(n_top, length(rv_excl148a)))]
mat_top_excl148a <- mat_excl148a[top_genes_excl148a, , drop = FALSE]

pc_excl148a <- prcomp(t(mat_top_excl148a), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
percentVar_excl148a <- 100 * (pc_excl148a$sdev^2) / sum(pc_excl148a$sdev^2)

cat("PC1 variance explained: original =", round(percentVar[1], 1),
    "%, excl. miR-148a-3p =", round(percentVar_excl148a[1], 1), "%\n")
cat("PC2 variance explained: original =", round(percentVar[2], 1),
    "%, excl. miR-148a-3p =", round(percentVar_excl148a[2], 1), "%\n\n")

scores_excl148a <- as.data.frame(pc_excl148a$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  left_join(rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(coldata), var = "Sample"), by = "Sample")

# ---- Recompute the same 16-test (2 activity x 4 timepoint x 2 PC)
# correlation grid on the miR-148a-3p-free PCA ----
pca_excl148a_results <- vector("list", nrow(test_plan))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(test_plan))) {
  activity  <- test_plan$Activity[i]
  tp        <- test_plan$Timepoint[i]
  pc        <- test_plan$PC[i]
  predictor <- activity_vars[[activity]][[tp]]

  res_pearson  <- run_correlation(scores_excl148a[[pc]], coldata[[predictor]], method = "pearson", B = B)
  res_spearman <- run_correlation(scores_excl148a[[pc]], coldata[[predictor]], method = "spearman", exact = TRUE, B = B)

  pca_excl148a_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    Activity = activity, Timepoint = tp, PC = pc,
    pearson_r_excl148a    = unname(res_pearson$cor_test$estimate),
    pearson_p_excl148a    = res_pearson$cor_test$p.value,
    spearman_rho_excl148a = unname(res_spearman$cor_test$estimate),
    spearman_p_excl148a   = res_spearman$cor_test$p.value
  )
}
pca_excl148a_summary <- bind_rows(pca_excl148a_results)
pca_excl148a_summary$pearson_p_adj_BH_excl148a  <- p.adjust(pca_excl148a_summary$pearson_p_excl148a, method = "BH")
pca_excl148a_summary$spearman_p_adj_BH_excl148a <- p.adjust(pca_excl148a_summary$spearman_p_excl148a, method = "BH")

# ---- Side-by-side with the original (miR-148a-3p-included) correlations ----
pca_148a_sensitivity <- correlation_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(Activity, Timepoint, PC, pearson_r, pearson_p, pearson_p_adj_BH,
                spearman_rho, spearman_p, spearman_p_adj_BH) %>%
  left_join(pca_excl148a_summary, by = c("Activity", "Timepoint", "PC")) %>%
  mutate(
    `Pearson same direction?`  = dplyr::if_else(sign(pearson_r) == sign(pearson_r_excl148a), "Yes", "No"),
    `Spearman same direction?` = dplyr::if_else(sign(spearman_rho) == sign(spearman_rho_excl148a), "Yes", "No")
  )

n_pearson_same <- sum(pca_148a_sensitivity$`Pearson same direction?` == "Yes")
cat(n_pearson_same, "/", nrow(pca_148a_sensitivity),
    "PC-activity-timepoint correlations retain the same direction with",
```

```{r fig7}
make_volcano <- function(results_obj, title, subtitle, n_total, output_file) {
  df <- as.data.frame(results_obj)

  p <- EnhancedVolcano(
    df,
    lab          = rownames(df),
    x            = "log2FoldChange",
    y            = "padj",
    title        = title,
    subtitle     = subtitle,
    titleLabSize    = 16,
    subtitleLabSize = 13,
    pCutoff      = 0.05,
    FCcutoff     = 1.0,
    pointSize    = 2.0,
    labSize      = 5.0,
    colAlpha     = 0.6,
    selectLab    = rownames(df)[!is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < 0.05],
    drawConnectors  = TRUE,
    widthConnectors = 0.5,
    max.overlaps    = 50,
    legendPosition  = "right",
    legendLabels    = c("NS", "Log2FC", "P-value", "P-value + Log2FC"),
    col          = c("grey60", "#0072B2", "#CC79A7", "#009E73"),
    xlim         = c(-6, 6),
    ylim         = c(0, 3.5),
    caption      = paste0("total = ", n_total, " variables")
  ) +
    theme(
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 13)
    )

  ggsave(output_file, plot = p,
         width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
  return(p)
}
```

# ============================================================
# SUPPLEMENTARY — Individual Normalized Counts for Significant miRNAs
# ============================================================
```{r indiv_counts_setup}
# Rebuilds the same dds object used inside run_deseq() for a given timepoint,
# but returns the dds itself (run_deseq() only returned results()) so we can
# pull DESeq2-normalized counts per sample.
get_dds_for_timepoint <- function(coldata, counts, group_col, ref_level) {
  coldata_filt <- coldata %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(group_col)) %>%
    filter(.data[[group_col]] != "Interquartile range") %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(grepl("Lower", .data[[group_col]]), "Low", "High")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Group)

  coldata_filt$Group <- factor(coldata_filt$Group, levels = c("Low", "High"))
  counts_filt        <- counts[, rownames(coldata_filt)]

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_filt,
                                colData   = coldata_filt,
                                design    = ~ Group)
  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) >= 5) >= 3, ]
  dds$Group <- relevel(dds$Group, ref = ref_level)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  return(dds)
}

export_individual_normcounts <- function(dds, degs_file, timepoint_label,
                                          output_csv, output_plot = NULL,
                                          point_size = 1.3) {
  if (!file.exists(degs_file)) {
    message("No DEG file found for ", timepoint_label, " — skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  degs <- read.csv(degs_file, row.names = 1)
  sig_mirnas <- rownames(degs)

  if (length(sig_mirnas) == 0) {
    message("No significant miRNAs for ", timepoint_label, " — skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
  sig_mirnas  <- intersect(sig_mirnas, rownames(norm_counts))
  norm_sub    <- norm_counts[sig_mirnas, , drop = FALSE]

  long_df <- as.data.frame(norm_sub) %>%
    rownames_to_column("miRNA") %>%
    pivot_longer(-miRNA, names_to = "ParticipantID", values_to = "NormalizedCount") %>%
    left_join(
      as.data.frame(colData(dds)) %>% rownames_to_column("ParticipantID") %>%
        dplyr::select(ParticipantID, Group),
      by = "ParticipantID"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Timepoint = timepoint_label) %>%
    arrange(miRNA, Group, ParticipantID)

  write.csv(long_df, output_csv, row.names = FALSE)

  n_mirna <- length(unique(long_df$miRNA))
  
  ncol_facet <- min(4, ceiling(sqrt(n_mirna)))

  p <- ggplot(long_df, aes(x = Group, y = NormalizedCount, color = Group)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = point_size, alpha = 0.85) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.35,
                 color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~ miRNA, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol_facet) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Low" = "red", "High" = "royalblue")) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Individual Normalized Counts \u2014 ", timepoint_label),
      x = NULL, y = "DESeq2-normalized count"
    ) +
    jn_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8))

  if (!is.null(output_plot)) {
    ggsave(output_plot, plot = p,
           width  = max(10, 6 * ncol_facet),
           height = max(8, 6 * ceiling(n_mirna / ncol_facet)),
           units = "cm", dpi = 300, compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
  }

  return(list(data = long_df, plot = p))
}
```

# ============================================================
# SUPPLEMENTARY — PC2 Loading Consistency for Significant miRNAs
# ============================================================
```{r pc2_consistency_setup}
# `pc`, `loadings`, and `scores` come from the FIGURE 6 PCA chunk above
# (prcomp on the top 500 most variable miRNAs; loadings = feature x PC
# rotation matrix). We reuse them rather than recomputing PCA, so the
# loading values here match what's reported in Figure 6.

check_pc_consistency <- function(res, loadings, scores, coldata, predictor_col,
                                  pc_col = "PC2", output_csv = NULL) {

  # Empirical sign of the PC vs. continuous sedentary-behavior correlation —
  # derived from the data rather than assumed, so this works regardless of
  # timepoint or which way PC2 happens to point.
  pred_vals <- coldata[scores$Sample, predictor_col]
  corr_sign <- sign(cor(scores[[pc_col]], pred_vals,
                         use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman"))

  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("miRNA") %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.10) %>%
    dplyr::select(miRNA, log2FoldChange, padj)

  loadings_pc <- loadings %>%
    dplyr::select(Feature, Loading = all_of(pc_col)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(miRNA = Feature)

  # Flag any significant miRNAs that fell outside the top-500-variable set
  # used for PCA (no loading available) — these can't be checked.
  missing <- setdiff(res_df$miRNA, loadings_pc$miRNA)
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    message("Note: ", length(missing),
            " significant miRNA(s) not in the PCA feature set (no loading): ",
            paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }

  out <- res_df %>%
    inner_join(loadings_pc, by = "miRNA") %>%
    mutate(
      # Contrast is Low vs High (numerator = Low = less sedentary):
      #   log2FC > 0  -> higher in Low  (less sedentary)
      #   log2FC < 0  -> higher in High (sedentary)
      `Direction in sedentary` = ifelse(log2FoldChange < 0,
                                          "\u2191 in sedentary",
                                          "\u2191 in less sedentary"),
      `PC direction` = ifelse(Loading > 0,
                               paste0("\u2191 with ", pc_col),
                               paste0("\u2193 with ", pc_col)),
      direction_actual  = -sign(log2FoldChange),      # +1 = up in sedentary
      direction_implied = corr_sign * sign(Loading),  # what the PCA implies
      `Consistent?` = ifelse(direction_actual == direction_implied, "Yes", "No")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(miRNA, log2FoldChange, `Direction in sedentary`,
                  Loading, `PC direction`, `Consistent?`) %>%
    arrange(desc(`Consistent?`))

  # Rename the last two columns as a plain assignment (pc_col is usually
  # "PC2", giving "log2FC" and "PC2 loading") instead of building the name
  # dynamically inside rename().
  colnames(out)[colnames(out) == "log2FoldChange"] <- "log2FC"
  colnames(out)[colnames(out) == "Loading"] <- paste0(pc_col, " loading")

  if (!is.null(output_csv)) write.csv(out, output_csv, row.names = FALSE)

  cat(pc_col, "vs.", predictor_col, "correlation sign used:",
      ifelse(corr_sign > 0, "positive", "negative"), "\n")

  # ---- Binomial test: is the agreement rate better than chance (50%)? ----
  # This is ONE aggregate test per timepoint (not one per miRNA) — the
  # per-miRNA multiple-testing burden was already handled upstream by
  # DESeq2's padj < 0.10 filter, so no further per-miRNA correction is
  # needed here. If testing multiple timepoints, correct across those
  # timepoint-level p-values (done in the calling chunk via p.adjust).
  n_total      <- nrow(out)
  n_consistent <- sum(out$`Consistent?` == "Yes")
  binom_res    <- binom.test(n_consistent, n_total, p = 0.5,
                              alternative = "two.sided")

  cat(n_consistent, "/", n_total, "miRNAs directionally consistent",
      "(raw binomial p =", signif(binom_res$p.value, 3), ")\n\n")

  return(list(table = out,
              n_consistent = n_consistent,
              n_total = n_total,
              p_value = binom_res$p.value))
}
```

```{r pc2_consistency_run}
# Focused on Trimester 1 and Trimester 2 (T2 has the most DEGs).
consistency_T2 <- check_pc_consistency(
  results_sedentary_T2, loadings, scores, coldata,
  predictor_col = "sed60num_trimester2", pc_col = "PC2",
  output_csv = "PC2_Consistency_T2.csv")

consistency_T1 <- check_pc_consistency(
  results_sedentary_T1, loadings, scores, coldata,
  predictor_col = "sed60num_trimester1", pc_col = "PC2",
  output_csv = "PC2_Consistency_T1.csv")

# consistency_T3 <- check_pc_consistency(
#   results_sedentary_T3, loadings, scores, coldata,
#   predictor_col = "sed60num_trimester3", pc_col = "PC2",
#   output_csv = "PC2_Consistency_T3.csv")

# ---- BH-correct the two timepoint-level binomial p-values ----
# (This corrects across the T1/T2 aggregate tests themselves — separate
# from, and in addition to, the DESeq2 padj filtering already applied
# per miRNA upstream.)
raw_p  <- c(T1 = consistency_T1$p_value, T2 = consistency_T2$p_value)
adj_p  <- p.adjust(raw_p, method = "BH")

cat("Trimester 1:", consistency_T1$n_consistent, "/", consistency_T1$n_total,
    "consistent | raw p =", signif(raw_p["T1"], 3),
    "| BH-adjusted p =", signif(adj_p["T1"], 3), "\n")
cat("Trimester 2:", consistency_T2$n_consistent, "/", consistency_T2$n_total,
    "consistent | raw p =", signif(raw_p["T2"], 3),
    "| BH-adjusted p =", signif(adj_p["T2"], 3), "\n")

knitr::kable(
  consistency_T2$table, digits = 3,
  caption = paste0("Trimester 2: DE direction vs. PC2 loading direction (",
                    consistency_T2$n_consistent, "/", consistency_T2$n_total,
                    " consistent; BH-adjusted binomial p = ",
                    signif(adj_p["T2"], 3), ")"))

knitr::kable(
  consistency_T1$table, digits = 3,
  caption = paste0("Trimester 1: DE direction vs. PC2 loading direction (",
                    consistency_T1$n_consistent, "/", consistency_T1$n_total,
                    " consistent; BH-adjusted binomial p = ",
                    signif(adj_p["T1"], 3), ")"))
```

```{r final_outputs}
  ),

  "Sensitivity_Analyses" = c(
    # miR-148a-3p exclusion (all 8 quartile comparisons)

  ),

  "Background_Lists" = c(
    "DIANA_background_miRNAs.txt"
  )
)

copy_status_list <- vector("list", length(final_files_by_category))

for (cat_i in seq_along(final_files_by_category)) {
  category  <- names(final_files_by_category)[cat_i]
  files     <- final_files_by_category[[cat_i]]
  cat_dir   <- file.path(final_dir, category)
  dir.create(cat_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  copied <- vapply(files, function(f) {
    if (file.exists(f)) {
      file.copy(f, file.path(cat_dir, f), overwrite = TRUE)
      TRUE
    } else {
      FALSE
    }
  }, logical(1))

  copy_status_list[[cat_i]] <- data.frame(
    category = category,
    file     = files,
    copied   = unname(copied),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  cat(sprintf("%-24s %d/%d files copied to %s/\n",
              category, sum(copied), length(files), cat_dir))
}

copy_status <- bind_rows(copy_status_list)

cat("\n", sum(copy_status$copied), "/", nrow(copy_status),
    "total files copied across", length(final_files_by_category), "folders.\n\n")

missing <- copy_status %>% filter(!copied)
if (nrow(missing) > 0) {
  cat("Not found (chunk may not have been run, or check filename):\n")
  print(missing[, c("category", "file")])
}

write.csv(copy_status, file.path(final_dir, "_manifest.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
